# sailpoint_approval_config (Resource)

Manages the approval reminders, escalation, timeout and fallback approver of a role, access profile, entitlement, or the whole tenant (`/generic-approvals/v1/config`, experimental). Create is an upsert: if the object already has its own approval config, Terraform takes it over. Destroy deletes the object's own config so it inherits the tenant config again; for `scope = "TENANT"` destroy only removes the resource from state. Every setting is optional: what you leave out keeps the value SailPoint has (or its default). Removing a block from the configuration keeps its last value; set `enabled = false` to turn a feature off. Requires `ORG_ADMIN`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reminders, escalation and fallback approver for one role
resource "sailpoint_approval_config" "finance_role" {
  scope     = "ROLE"
  object_id = "REPLACE_WITH_ROLE_ID"

  reminder_config = {
    enabled                   = true
    days_until_first_reminder = 2
    reminder_cron_schedule    = "@every 48h"
    max_reminders             = 3
  }

  escalation_config = {
    enabled                     = true
    days_until_first_escalation = 7
    escalation_cron_schedule    = "@every 72h"
    escalation_chain = [
      { identity_type = "MANAGER_OF" },
      { identity_type = "GOVERNANCE_GROUP", identity_id = "REPLACE_WITH_GOVERNANCE_GROUP_ID" },
    ]
  }

  timeout_config = {
    enabled            = true
    days_until_timeout = 30
    timeout_result     = "EXPIRED"
  }

  cron_timezone = {
    location = "Europe/Paris"
  }

  fallback_approver = {
    type        = "GOVERNANCE_GROUP"
    identity_id = "REPLACE_WITH_GOVERNANCE_GROUP_ID"
  }
}

# Only override the timeout of one access profile; everything else keeps SailPoint's value
resource "sailpoint_approval_config" "vpn_access" {
  scope     = "ACCESS_PROFILE"
  object_id = "REPLACE_WITH_ACCESS_PROFILE_ID"

  timeout_config = {
    enabled            = true
    days_until_timeout = 14
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (String) ID of the role, access profile or entitlement. For `TENANT`, the tenant ID.
- `scope` (String) What `object_id` points to: `ROLE`, `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ENTITLEMENT` or `TENANT`.

### Optional

- `auto_approve` (String) `OFF`, `DIRECT` or `INDIRECT`: whether steps assigned to the requester are auto-approved.
- `circumvent_approval_process` (Boolean) When `true`, approvals are created as passed, skipping approval. Intended for machine account approvals only.
- `cron_timezone` (Attributes) Timezone for the reminder and escalation schedules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cron_timezone))
- `escalation_config` (Attributes) Escalation of pending requests to other approvers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--escalation_config))
- `fallback_approver` (Attributes) Approver used when the assigned approver cannot be found and no escalation applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fallback_approver))
- `machine_identity_manager_assignment` (String) How `MANAGER_OF` resolves when the requestee is a machine identity (default `MANAGER_OF_REQUESTER`).
- `reminder_config` (Attributes) Reminders sent to approvers while a request is pending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reminder_config))
- `requires_comment` (String) When approvers must comment: `APPROVAL`, `REJECTION`, `ALL` or `OFF`.
- `serial_chain` (Attributes List) Approvers in order, used when the request's approval criteria is `SERIAL`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--serial_chain))
- `timeout_config` (Attributes) When a pending request expires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeout_config))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<scope>/<object_id>`, e.g. `ROLE/2c9180...`. Also the import ID.

<a id="nestedatt--cron_timezone"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cron_timezone`

Optional:

- `location` (String) IANA timezone, e.g. `Europe/Paris`.
- `offset` (String) Timezone offset, if no location is set.


<a id="nestedatt--escalation_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `escalation_config`

Optional:

- `days_until_first_escalation` (Number) Days before the first escalation.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether escalation is enabled.
- `escalation_chain` (Attributes List) Who the request escalates to, in order (the first item is tier 1). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--escalation_config--escalation_chain))
- `escalation_cron_schedule` (String) Schedule of the following escalations, in robfig/cron syntax (e.g. `@every 72h`).

<a id="nestedatt--escalation_config--escalation_chain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `escalation_config.escalation_chain`

Required:

- `identity_type` (String) Approver type, e.g. `MANAGER_OF`, `IDENTITY`, `GOVERNANCE_GROUP`, `ROLE_OWNER`, `ACCESS_PROFILE_OWNER`, `ENTITLEMENT_OWNER`, `SOURCE_OWNER`.

Optional:

- `identity_id` (String) ID of the identity or governance group, when `identity_type` is `IDENTITY` or `GOVERNANCE_GROUP`.



<a id="nestedatt--fallback_approver"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fallback_approver`

Optional:

- `identity_id` (String) ID of the identity or governance group, when `type` is `IDENTITY` or `GOVERNANCE_GROUP`.
- `type` (String) Approver type, same values as `identity_type`.


<a id="nestedatt--reminder_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reminder_config`

Optional:

- `days_until_first_reminder` (Number) Days before the first reminder.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether reminders are sent.
- `max_reminders` (Number) Maximum number of reminders (at most 20).
- `reminder_cron_schedule` (String) Schedule of the following reminders, in robfig/cron syntax (e.g. `@every 48h`).


<a id="nestedatt--serial_chain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `serial_chain`

Required:

- `identity_type` (String) Approver type, e.g. `MANAGER_OF`, `IDENTITY`, `GOVERNANCE_GROUP`, `ROLE_OWNER`, `ACCESS_PROFILE_OWNER`, `ENTITLEMENT_OWNER`, `SOURCE_OWNER`.

Optional:

- `identity_id` (String) ID of the identity or governance group, when `identity_type` is `IDENTITY` or `GOVERNANCE_GROUP`.


<a id="nestedatt--timeout_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeout_config`

Optional:

- `days_until_timeout` (Number) Days before the request times out (at most 90).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether requests time out.
- `timeout_result` (String) Outcome on timeout: `EXPIRED` or `APPROVED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Import format: <scope>/<object_id>. Scope is ROLE, ACCESS_PROFILE, ENTITLEMENT or TENANT.
# Importing an object that only inherits the tenant config fails with "Cannot import non-existent remote object".
terraform import sailpoint_approval_config.finance_role "ROLE/REPLACE_WITH_ROLE_ID"
```
